description: Compare the configuration index reported by the public read API with the index of the configuration the node is actually using. The harness brings a real single-voter cluster to the leader state with the bootstrap configuration committed, admits one configuration-index probe (the live latest configuration index), then reads Raft.GetConfiguration().Index() and Raft.Stats()['latest_configuration_index'] on the same node. The check discriminates whether the reported index identifies the latest configuration or is a value the constructor never assigns.

harness.description: Single-voter in-memory cluster driven to the leader state; the harness admits one config_index_probe carrying the live latest configuration index and then reports the index returned by GetConfiguration().Index() plus the Stats readout.
semantic_changes: election/heartbeat/lease timeouts are shortened and the log level is raised to ERROR so the single-voter election completes quickly
the harness reads the live latest configuration index for the probe and the public API readout for the result; no target source is replaced

legality.derivation: Raft.GetConfiguration constructs a configurationsFuture with only the configuration value populated from the atomic latest-configuration copy and responds immediately, while configurationsFuture.Index() returns configurationsFuture.configurations.latestIndex, documented as the index of the latest configuration in use. The same future Index() feeds the latest_configuration_index entry of Raft.Stats. The probe records the index at which the node's latest configuration was actually written (the bootstrap configuration entry), so the public readout and the live configuration index are two observations of the same quantity.
legality.applicability: A committed single-voter cluster whose latest configuration is the bootstrap configuration written at index 1 and whose leader has committed an entry of its own term; only the public readout path is exercised, no fault is injected and no other component is changed.
unresolved: Whether any consumer outside this repository depends on the reported index is not observable from the snapshot.
alternatives: the configurationsCh path used by snapshot creation fills both the configuration and its index from a main-loop clone and would report the index correctly, so the discrepancy is specific to the synchronous GetConfiguration constructor

grounding.derivation: ConfigurationFuture exposes Index, and configurationsFuture documents that Index as the index of the latest configuration in use; the caller's fence for a later membership change is that index, since nextConfiguration rejects a change whose prevIndex no longer matches the current configuration index. A readout that returns the never-assigned zero value cannot serve that purpose.
grounding.applicability: Applies to a node whose latest configuration is known and committed; the compared quantity is the public readout's index against the index at which the latest configuration was written.

observable_properties.description: The index reported by GetConfiguration().Index() must equal the index at which the node's latest configuration was written.

uncertainties: The check observes one committed single-voter configuration; a later configuration change would keep the same constructor behaviour but is not exercised here.
